title: Mark Done through a typed decision and compose Done state in review cases

intentCoverage.report:
Dough Intent Coverage: SEED-413#split-done-mark-decision-from-store at 6ff2b1d9ca8eb435fd60e97aa09e035821f3d759

Verdict: Confirmed missing test path (bounded to the checks examined below).

Promise: "Every replaced case keeps its assertions"; Done marking stays the topic in specs that prove the capture or the adapter's persistence. Expected behavior: when a Default main session's checkout was shared meanwhile, Done stores sessionCommits.shared = true, so the review says session: { shared: true }.

Fault (the suggested one, validated against this revision): dashboard/server/doneCapture.ts, settleSessionCommits, line `captured = { ...read, shared };` changed to `void shared; captured = { ...read };`. checkoutSharedMeanwhile still runs, but its result is no longer stored. Fixtures and assertions were left as they were.

Scratch checkout: a detached worktree at the revision. `npm ci --ignore-scripts`. Pre-probe state was clean (empty `git status --porcelain`). Load average was about 9 to 14.

Runs:
1. Baseline. dashboard/backend-tests/review/done-kept-session-shared-checkout.spec.ts passed 5/5 (1.51 to 2.37 s). An independent scratch witness, dashboard/backend-tests/review/ic-shared-witness.spec.ts, also passed. It follows the fd05ea2d2 shape: two Default main launches kept through `keep`, two dated commits, real `markDone(typo)`, then it reads `keptRecords(source)`. It printed stored sessionCommits {..., "shared": true} and review.session {..., "shared": true}.
2. Faulted. The maintained shared-checkout spec still passed 5/5. The witness failed: stored sessionCommits came back with no `shared` field ("expected undefined to be true" at sessionCommits.shared). That is the wrong behavior on the intended path, observed independently. The review read (server/storyReviewSessionCommits.ts:53,121) sets session.shared only when capture.shared === true, so the review loses "shared". Four nearby Done-capture specs that still run real markDone on session commits also passed 18/18 under the fault, and none of them mentions `shared`: done-kept-session-commits, ad-hoc-session-commits-done, done-kept-session-unavailable and done-kept-commit-refs-release.
3. Restored. The file was copied back, `git diff` was empty, and the shared-checkout spec plus the witness passed 6/6. The witness spec and test-results were then deleted, `git status --porcelain --ignored` showed nothing outside node_modules, and the scratch worktree was removed with `git worktree remove --force`.

Checks examined and the transition they skip:
- In done-kept-session-shared-checkout.spec.ts, the cases "two sessions open together ..." and the two "does not share" cases unit-test checkoutSharedMeanwhile directly. The case "two default launches open in one checkout both commit ..." builds records with `keptSessionCommits({ ..., shared: true })` and only proves the review read.
- No examined check runs the step from checkoutSharedMeanwhile's answer to the stored sessionCommits.shared through the real Done capture or adapter (settleSessionCommits). Before this story, that step was proved by `await markDone(typo, minutesAgo(15)); expect(await review(typo)).toMatchObject(sharedReview)` in the fd05ea2d2 version. That assertion was lost when the case moved to a composed record.

Next proof action: add an adapter- or capture-level case that marks a shared Default main session Done through production (setRecordDoneAt / settleSessionCommits) and asserts that the stored sessionCommits.shared is true, or that its review says session: { shared: true }.

Matching prior disposition (recognized, not a new decision): the evidence matches finding 2 of the already-planned correction SEED-413#restore-done-capture-proof-after-composed-reviews, .planning/slice-plans/743-restore-done-capture-proof-after-composed-reviews/PLAN.md. That plan states "Done no longer proves it stores `shared`" and plans an assertion on `sessionCommits.shared`, and its fault list includes "removing `shared` from `settleSessionCommits`". This probe confirms that finding by running the fault. Test repair and routing stay with the caller.

Costs:
- Test runtime (measured, Vitest "Duration" per run, wall seconds): baseline 2.37 s (5 tests) + witness baseline 1.22 s; faulted 1.51 s + 0.86 s, plus the nearby four-spec run 10.73 s; restored 3.34 s. Total about 20.0 s of runner time. This excludes npm ci and worktree setup.
- Human effort: unavailable. No human time was observed or recorded for this probe.
- Agent effort: unavailable. No token or turn meter is exposed to this agent, so there is no supported measure.
- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 105954 ms (measured), from 1795193655753 to 1795193761707 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

## Wrap-up disposition

Checked revision `6ff2b1d9c`. Evidence: the faulted `settleSessionCommits` passed every maintained check while an independent Done witness lost `sessionCommits.shared`. Decision: the gap fits the queued retrospective correction [SEED-413#restore-done-capture-proof-after-composed-reviews](seeds/SEED-413-renovate-dashboard-unit-tests.md#restore-done-capture-proof-after-composed-reviews) (plan 743, finding 2 and slice 1), which already owns this proof and fault; its plan now links this report. No new queue entry. The fault does not fail this project's ordinary test entry or CI.
